$schema: UNVERIFIED — see RATIONALE.md and ../token-safety-check/workflow.json. Recipe form, not the literal KeeperHub canvas schema.
name: StablecoinPriceCheck
description: Cross-pool DEX-derived stablecoin price + depeg signal. Demo workflow for the keepertoll x402 marketplace.

chain.comment: v0.1 only ships Base mainnet pool addresses; extend the pool table to add chains.

output.prices: Array<{ pair: string, pool: string, priceUsd: number }>

constants.comment: UNVERIFIED — pool addresses are the canonical Uniswap V3 pools on Base mainnet for the major stablecoin pairs at 0.01% / 0.05% fee tiers. Confirm against https://app.uniswap.org/pools before publishing.

nodes.comment: Pick the relevant pool addresses for the requested stablecoin.
UNVERIFIED node type. eth_call slot0() on each pool to get sqrtPriceX96.

params.abi_function: function slot0() view returns (uint160 sqrtPriceX96, int24 tick, uint16, uint16, uint16, uint8, bool)

nodes.comment: Convert sqrtPriceX96 → human-decimal stablecoin price. Uniswap V3 price = (sqrtPriceX96 / 2^96)^2 * 10^(decimals0 - decimals1). For USDC/USDT/DAI all stablecoin pairs, the result is in token1-per-token0 and we normalise to the requested stablecoin's USD price.
Median + max pairwise deviation + confidence label.
